Should read receipts be sent to other users? If off, they use the private type, which only syncs to your own devices.
Should typing notifications be sent to other users?
Should the composer offer fetching URL previews to bundle in outgoing messages?
Should read receipts be shown in the timeline?
If off, images and videos only appear (and download) once tapped. This also hides images in URL previews.
Whether GIFs in the timeline play on their own. If off, they show still (downloading only a thumbnail, if there is one) until tapped.
If off, custom emoji and other inline images aren\'t drawn: their text is shown instead.
Whether long lines in code blocks wrap instead of scrolling sideways.
Events with nothing of their own to show (reactions, edits, deletions, unknown types) as a line with their type.
Whether deleted messages should leave a placeholder behind in the timeline.
Whether joins, leaves, invites and the like should be visible in the timeline.
Whether name and avatar changes should be visible in the timeline.
Whether to show URL previews bundled in messages (MSC4095).
Whether thread messages should only take a single line in the main timeline.
Whether messages on different days should have a date between them.
Whether to show custom emoji packs provided by the room. If off, only your personal packs are offered.
Whether to show the screen for adjusting media (resizing, caption) before it\'s sent.
Avoid sending data that\'s easily fingerprintable: no URL previews in messages, and no commands for bots.
The widest images get in the timeline (gomuks web pixels; 320 by default).
Should the room list show a preview of the last message?
How much space room list entries take.
Always keep favourite rooms at the top of the room list, whatever the recent activity.
Always keep low priority rooms at the bottom of the room list, whatever the recent activity.
Don\'t count unread messages in low priority rooms. Notifications and mentions still count.
